name: Mikrorajon
source:
Night is falling on an ordinary post-soviet neighborhood. The holidays start tomorrow, which means you can stay up and have fun until morning! It remains to find a company...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
夜幕正悄然笼罩一片寻常的后苏联居民区。明天假期就要开始了，这意味着你可以彻夜不眠，尽情狂欢到天亮！现在只差找个伴儿了……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537050/]Steam[/url]]
